Photo Courtesy of Midwest Racing News
In 1963 and 1964, Parnelli Jones of Palos Verdes, Calif., won seven consecutive late model stock car races
here at state fair park. But the press clippings didn't help much in the July 9 200 miler here as Don White of
Keokuk, Iowa (#2-1967 Dodge Charger) battled Jones for second place early in the event. White eventually
passed Jones who had led for the first 30 miles of the race. Jones later dropped out while White went on to
win the race.

National Champ in a Bind
OODGE
FORD
Photos Courtesy of Midwest Racing News
Mario Andretti of Nazareth, Pa. (#11-1967 Ford) had nothing but trouble in the early laps of the July 9
200 mile stock car race here. First, the talented little Italian import spun in the south turn on the second mile.
Don White of Keokuk, Iowa (#2-1967 Dodge Charger), the eventual winner, barely slipped past Andretti's
errant mount. In the lower photo, Andretti gets his car back into traffic as J. C. Klotz of Fort Wayne, Ind.,
spins in the foreground. Others in the picture are: #55-Eddie Meyer; #4-Sal Tovella; #41-Bill Cheesbourg;
#97-Frank Freda and #8-Roger Regeth. Andretti later drove his way back into fourth place.
